Generated Narrative: CodeSystem em-unit-response-status

This case-sensitive code system https://nshr-uat.sha.go.ke/fhir/CodeSystem/em-unit-response-status defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
dispatched DispatchedThe unit has been assigned to the incident but has not yet begun moving.
en-route En routeThe unit is travelling to the incident scene.
on-scene On sceneThe unit has arrived at the incident scene.
transporting TransportingThe unit is transporting the patient to a receiving facility.
at-facility At facilityThe unit has arrived at the receiving facility.
stood-down Stood downThe unit has been relieved or stood down from the incident.
